title: SRS Document View JSON Projection Output (ext:views-l2)
description: Machine-readable projection produced by rendering a DocumentView with format 'json'. Contains document metadata, ordered sections, and typed record data. Not a rendered markup document.

documentViewId.description: ID of the DocumentView that produced this projection.

containerId.description: Container ID derived from the first ContainerSubset section source. Null when no ContainerSubset source is present in the view.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this projection was generated.

containerTitle.description: Human-readable container title resolved at render time.

preamble.description: Evaluated DocumentView.preamble string. Heading variables ({{heading-N}}) are substituted as empty strings.

typeVersion.description: Version of the Type this record was projected from (Record.typeVersion, RFC-032/RFC-039) — the authoritative half of the record-to-type PINNED binding alongside typeId.

recordHeading.description: Value of the titleFieldId field, if the section declares one and the record has it.

preamble.description: Evaluated export_config.preamble for this record. Heading variables substituted as empty strings. Present only when the section's render view has an ExportConfig.preamble.

fields.description: Typed field values keyed by Field.name (RFC-039 [R11]). Values are raw JSON (string, number, boolean, array, or object); a composite value is carried recursively under its own key, exactly as in the instance. Empty/absent fields are omitted when omitEmptyFields is true.

orderedFieldKeys.description: Field.name keys in FieldAssignment.order — the iteration order for fields.

relations.description: RFC-027 [I-027-8]. Present only when the section declares relationsPresentation and this record has surviving link rows; rows in display order. Omitted when no edges survive selection.

properties.description: RFC-041 [R8]. Present only when the section's render view declares at least one RecordPropertyView row and this record has at least one surviving (non-omitted, [R4]) row; rows in ascending View.fieldViews[].order. Omitted when no property row survives selection.

property.description: RFC-041 Change B closed, generated enum — the RecordPropertyView.property this row presents.

label.description: Resolved row label per RFC-041 Change C: RecordPropertyView.displayLabel if set, else the per-property default (Status/Tags/Created/Updated).

value.description: Resolved value per RFC-041 Change C: lifecycleState resolves through the bound Lifecycle's LifecycleState.label when [R6] applies, otherwise the raw state key; tags is the raw string array; createdAt/updatedAt are raw ISO-8601 strings.

direction.description: Whether the record is the source (forward) or target (inverse) of the listed edges. Display-only; only forward edges are stored (Invariant 16).

label.description: Resolved row label per RFC-027 Change B.

targets.description: Related instances in display order: display label ascending, instanceId ascending tiebreak, both by Unicode code point (RFC-027 [I-027-5]).

displayLabel.description: Resolved per RFC-027 Change C rule 5 (effective identityFieldId → section titleFieldId → instanceId).
